```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(stringr)
#load(here("Data","cbb_AS26_expt_1000bs_updated.RData"))
load(file = here("Data", "cbb_AS26_expt_1000bs_updatedw9icra3.RData"))
load(here("Data", "Alls.cor_clean.RData"))
cluster_summary<-read.csv(here("Outputs", "ed50_colorslope_cluster_metadata.csv"))
seqID<-read.csv(here("Data", "TUT_seq.csv"))

# seqID$SampleID_clean <- cleaned_names

# annot_master <- cluster_summary %>%
#   left_join(seqID, by = "SampleID_clean") %>%
#   mutate(seqID_flag = ifelse(!is.na(Name), "D", NA))

# Check to see how many "D"s are entered
# table(annot_master$seqID_flag, useNA = "always")

annot_master<-cluster_summary
  
# Grab the hclust object directly from your pvclust output
my_hclust <- cbb$hclust
# --- 1. RESET: Keep the hclust object completely untouched ---
# Do NOT clean my_hclust$labels. Leave them messy so pheatmap can map them natively.
my_hclust <- cbb$hclust
original_labels <- my_hclust$labels


# --- 2. Align the physiological matrix data natively ---
# Match the rows of your matrix to the original messy tree labels
heatmap_matrix <- Alls.cor_clean[match(original_labels, rownames(Alls.cor_clean)), ] %>%
  as.matrix()

# Transpose, scale, and cap outliers
heatmap_matrix_scaled <- t(scale(heatmap_matrix))
heatmap_matrix_scaled[heatmap_matrix_scaled > 3]  <- 3
heatmap_matrix_scaled[heatmap_matrix_scaled < -3] <- -3

# CRITICAL: Keep the column names messy to match the tree!
colnames(heatmap_matrix_scaled) <- original_labels


# --- 3. Update the Metadata to Match the Messy Labels ---
# We will create a temporary column in annot_master that mimics the messy file names
annot_messy <- annot_master %>%
  distinct(SampleID_clean, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Create a lookup dataframe matching messy names to clean names
lookup_df <- data.frame(
  MessyID = original_labels,
  SampleID_clean = original_labels %>%
    toupper() %>%
    sub("\\.processed\\.csv$", "", .) %>%
    sub("\\._?\\d{2,3}r$", "", .) %>%
    trimws()
)

# Join the lookup back to your metadata
annotation_col <- lookup_df %>%
  left_join(annot_messy, by = "SampleID_clean")

# Establish the messy names as the row names so pheatmap can map them
rownames(annotation_col) <- annotation_col$MessyID

# Select your tracks and convert to factors
annotation_col <- annotation_col %>% 
  dplyr::select(Species, K_3, K_4,K_15, ED50) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Species, K_3, K_4,K_15), as.factor))

#write.csv(annotation_col, file = here( "Data", "annotation_col.csv"))

# Explicitly match the row names to the matrix columns
#rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)
# rownames(annotation_col) <- annotation_col$SampleID_clean
# annotation_col$SampleID_clean <- NULL


# filter out Fm/Fo and isolate your 9 metrics (redundant)
metric_names <- rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)
keep_metrics <- metric_names[!metric_names %in% c("Fm", "Fo", "fm", "fo")]
heatmap_matrix_scaled <- heatmap_matrix_scaled[keep_metrics, ]

# save this for permanova
permanova_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[, colnames(heatmap_matrix) %in% keep_metrics]
permanova_matrix <- as.matrix(permanova_matrix)
storage.mode(permanova_matrix) <- "numeric"
write.csv(permanova_matrix, file = here("Outputs", "permanova_matrix_clean.csv"), row.names = TRUE)
save(permanova_matrix, file = here("Outputs", "permanova_matrix_clean.Rdata"))

#rename metrics to catagorize into families (check with Sophie if these are right)
metric_names <- rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)

metric_families <- data.frame(
  Metric = metric_names,
  Family = case_when(
    grepl("firDer|secDer", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)              ~ "OJIP Kinetics (Derivatives)",
    grepl("nCon", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)                        ~ "Connect (Normalized Curves)",
    grepl("MTFm|Ratio", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)                  ~ "OJIP Ratios & Area",
    grepl("quant|fvfm|yield|fv_fm", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)      ~ "Quant (Quantum Yield)",
    grepl("sigma|sig", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)                  ~ "Sigma (Antenna Size)",
    grepl("connect|conn", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)               ~ "Connect (Connectivity)",
    grepl("tau1|tau_1|\\bt1\\b", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)        ~ "Tau1 (Transport Kinetics 1)",
    grepl("tau2|tau_2|\\bt2\\b", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)        ~ "Tau2 (Transport Kinetics 2)",
    grepl("npq", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)                        ~ "NPQ (Non-Photochemical Quenching)",
    grepl("qp", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)                         ~ "qP (Photochemical Quenching)",
    grepl("abq", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)                        ~ "ABQ (Absorption)",
    grepl("qm", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)                         ~ "qm (Max Quenching)",
    TRUE                                                                  ~ "Other Metric"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
#look at what other metrics are
head(rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)[metric_families$Family == "Other Metric"], 10)

#save this for later plotting
save(metric_families, file = here("Data", "metric_families.Rdata"))


# sorted_order <- heatmap_matrix_scaled$Family
# 
# heatmap_matrix_scaled <- heatmap_matrix_scaled[sorted_order, ]

annotation_row <- data.frame(
  Family = metric_families$Family,
  row.names = metric_families$Metric
)

sorted_order <- order(annotation_row$Family)

heatmap_matrix_scaled <- heatmap_matrix_scaled[sorted_order, ]
annotation_row        <- annotation_row[sorted_order, , drop = FALSE]

#annotation_row <- annotation_row[rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled), , drop = FALSE]

# Define the high-contrast colors and breaks
my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "white", "darkred"))(100)
my_breaks <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 101)

#plot heatmap
jpeg(
  file = here("Plots", "Sorted_Grouped_Physiological_Heatmap_k3415.jpg"), 
  width = 12, 
  height = 10, 
  units = "in", 
  res = 300
)

pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix_scaled,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_row = annotation_row,
  show_colnames  = FALSE,         
  show_rownames  = FALSE, 
  cluster_rows   = FALSE,         
  cluster_cols   = my_hclust,     
  color          = my_palette,           
  breaks         = my_breaks,           
  main           = "Sorted MAPP Fluorescence Metrics vs. Phenotypic Clusters",
  margins        = c(5, 20)       # <--- [Column_Margin, Row_Margin]. Increase 12 if names are long!
)

dev.off()
```
